success_signal.description: Expected dated pipeline log with daily_outbound: done marker

diagnostics.default_recommended_fix: Check launchd state, the launchd stderr log, and Python or venv path resolution before re-running the daily pipeline.

success_signal.description: Expected successful pull_events job run within the freshness window

diagnostics.default_recommended_fix: Check cron, Smartlead connectivity, and the pull_events job log.

success_signal.description: Expected successful deliverability job run within the freshness window

diagnostics.default_recommended_fix: Check cron and the deliverability job log. If Smartlead is degraded, pause retry until API health returns.

freshness_checks.name: salesforce_folloze_signal_events
freshness_checks.sql: SELECT MAX(ingested_timestamp_utc) AS last_seen FROM signal_events WHERE source = 'salesforce_folloze_task'

freshness_checks.name: folloze_people_csv_signal_events
freshness_checks.sql: SELECT MAX(ingested_timestamp_utc) AS last_seen FROM signal_events WHERE source = 'folloze_people_csv'

freshness_checks.name: contact_signal_state
freshness_checks.sql: SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_seen FROM contact_signal_state

freshness_checks.name: outbound_briefs
freshness_checks.sql: SELECT MAX(created_at) AS last_seen FROM outbound_briefs

freshness_checks.name: asset_catalog
freshness_checks.sql: SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_seen FROM asset_catalog

metric_checks.name: resolved_top_asset_count_3d
metric_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS metric_value FROM contact_signal_state WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND top_asset_id IS NOT NULL

metric_checks.name: passing_outbound_briefs_3d
metric_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS metric_value FROM outbound_briefs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND gate_status = 'passed'

metric_checks.name: outbound_brief_pass_rate_3d
metric_checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN gate_status = 'passed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0)::double precision AS metric_value FROM outbound_briefs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'
